items.h: McCarthy (ankle) remains on the 53-man roster for the Vikings, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: There was talk leading up to cut-down day that McCarthy could be traded or even released, but he will remain with Minnesota for the time being. Kyler Murray will open the season as the starting quarterback for the Vikings, and either McCarthy or Carson Wentz will back him up.
